gold_heading_eval.passed: 20/20 (from DSE-020 pipeline run, prior to git commit)
gold_heading_eval.details: Original DSE-020 heading scorer run before Phase C feature changes

delta.zero_heading_change_description: Increased (regression — Phase C stricter penalties pushed marginal headings below 0.5)
delta.regressed_headings_profile: Near-miss headings (0.48-0.50) that dropped below threshold — mainly Star Health numbered items like '5. Cancellation:', '2. Claim Procedure:', all-caps titles like 'FAMILY ACCIDENT CARE INSURANCE POLICY', and marginal numbered lines
delta.permissive_changes_effect: Letter-numbering pattern and reduced sentence-case penalty did NOT help any zero-heading policies at t=0.5. All Phase C permissive changes targeted features absent from the zero-heading policies (letter-numbering requires 'A.' prefix; reduced sentence-case requires bold+numbered style).
delta.strict_changes_effect: TOC dot penalty (+0.10→-0.30, net -0.40), tab penalty (-0.30), and short all-caps penalty (-0.25) pushed 24 policies' marginal headings below 0.5 threshold. These policies had 1-2 marginal headings pre-Phase-C scoring.

acceptance_criteria.zero_clause_reduction_note: Zero-clause policies increased from 132 to 156. Phase C heading scorer changes at threshold 0.5 did NOT reduce zero-clause count — stricter penalties outweighed permissive additions for non-gold policies.

conclusion: Phase C heading scorer feature changes at threshold 0.5 do NOT reduce the zero-clause count. Zero-clause policies increased from 132 to 156 (+24). The three stricter penalties (TOC dots, tab, short all-caps) were more impactful than the two permissive additions (letter-numbering, reduced sentence-case). 15/24 regressed policies are Star Health — their format relies on marginal numbered headings that the new penalties push below threshold. Gold heading eval remains 20/20 PASS and gold section tree remains 19/20 FAIL (pre-existing). Zero-clause reduction requires a different strategy — either threshold lowering (t=0.45 with FP suppression infra) or targeted scorer additions that specifically address the 132 zero-heading policies (e.g., format-specific detectors for Star Health, HDFC ERGO, Aditya Birla layouts).
next_recommended_steps: DSE-024 Phase D2: Investigate format-specific heading features for top insurers (Star Health 15/24 regressed, HDFC ERGO 21/132 original)
Alternatively: DSE-024 Phase E: Threshold lowering to t=0.45 with classifier-based FP filtering (requires TOC/list-item classifier infra)
Alternatively: Close DSE-024 and move to DSE-021 extractors (zero-clause is a parser limitation that threshold changes can't fully resolve)
